summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi Quantum Computing 2x Daily ETF (XQTM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of the Corgi Quantum Computing ETF (Ticker: CQTM), through derivatives such as swaps and options. XQTM was launched on Jun 30, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
